a letter for you 💌

A few words I needed you to have.

Dear Baban,

Happy Birthday to my man 🎂🎀

May this year bring you all the happiness and you get what you want the most.

You are the Love of My Life whom I have never imagined I will get, you are my peace, my home. Without you a day feels like a whole year. I genuinely cannot imagine a day without you.

I never knew there would be someone who loves me the way I want. I never knew there would be someone without whom I can't live, someone whom I want every day, every second, every minute of my life. Remember it — I need you for my whole life.

You are so special to me. I don't know why, but you are. Whatever you have done with me, I don't know how, when, or how much I love you — and I will love you this way for the rest of my life.

Maybe not your good days, but I will always be with you in your bad days. Whenever you want me, I will always be there for you.

I hope I make your life a little better than before, and I will try to make it a better place for you to live in. I know you have faced a lot. I hope you don't have to face anything bad again. From my side, you will never have to face anything cruel or anything that will break your heart or your trust. You are always in a safe place with me.

I wish every day you get the smile which I like the most. And I love you so much, Baban. You are my cutest teddy, sexiest man, hottie baby and at last, my future Husband ❤️

Stay blessed and stay mine.

Your mammam 😚
